question: How many of our patients carry a heart failure diagnosis? CHF, systolic, diastolic, end-stage — I want all of them in one number.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Distinct patients. Heart failure = conditions record with SNOMED 88805009, any ICD-10 I50.*, or a description containing 'heart failure' or 'CHF' (e.g. 'Chronic congestive heart failure', 'Chronic systolic CHF', 'CHF, unspecified', 'End-stage heart failure'). Condition records are undated; no medication or NT-proBNP inference.

question: Nephrology wants a list: everyone whose most recent eGFR is under 60.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. eGFR results = labs named 'eGFR' (units 'mL/min/1.73m2' and 'mL/min/1.73m²' are the same measure) or 'Glomerular filtration rate', with a numeric value, an event_date and not cancelled. Undated results cannot be 'most recent' and are ignored. Most recent = latest event_date; if several results share that date the lowest is used. Qualifies when strictly below 60 (exactly 60 does not qualify). Patients with no dated eGFR are excluded. No CKD diagnosis required.

question: For the women's health program: how many women 65 and older have both diabetes and hypertension?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Diabetes = conditions record with ICD-10 E10/E11/E13, SNOMED 44054006, a description containing 'diabetes mellitus' (excluding 'Family history of...'; includes diabetic complication entries such as 'Disorder of kidney due to diabetes mellitus') or 'T1DM'/'T2DM'; prediabetes, hyperglycemia and gestational diabetes are not diabetes. Hypertension = conditions record with SNOMED 59621000, ICD-10 I10-I13/I15/I16, a description containing 'hypertension' (excluding pulmonary hypertension) or 'HTN'. Age = LATEST reported age: the most recent demographic_updates age_reported (2028 confirmations, 1-3 years older than the roster) if present, otherwise the roster age_reported captured 2026-08-28; no birth dates exist. Women = roster sex_reported 'F'. 65 and older is inclusive. Both conditions required (AND).

question: Possible missed diabetes: prediabetes on the problem list, no diabetes diagnosis, but latest A1c at 6.5 or higher. How many?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Prediabetes = conditions SNOMED 714628002, ICD-10 R73.03 or description 'Prediabetes'. Diabetes = conditions record with ICD-10 E10/E11/E13, SNOMED 44054006, a description containing 'diabetes mellitus' (excluding 'Family history of...'; includes diabetic complication entries such as 'Disorder of kidney due to diabetes mellitus') or 'T1DM'/'T2DM'; prediabetes, hyperglycemia and gestational diabetes are not diabetes. Patients with any diabetes entry are excluded (NOT). A1c results = labs named 'HbA1c', 'Hemoglobin A1c' or 'Hemoglobin A1c/Hemoglobin.total', numeric, dated, not cancelled; undated A1c rows cannot be 'latest' and are ignored. Latest = max event_date, same-day ties use the lowest value. Qualifies when >= 6.5 (inclusive).

question: pull resp registry — asthma or COPD pts (count emphysema + chronic obstructive bronchitis as COPD)
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Union (OR), distinct patients. Asthma = conditions SNOMED 195967001 or 233678006 (childhood asthma), ICD-10 J45.*, or description containing 'asthma'. COPD = ICD-10 J44.*, SNOMED 87433001 (pulmonary emphysema) or 185086009 (chronic obstructive bronchitis), or description containing 'COPD', 'emphysema' or 'chronic obstructive'. All ages.

question: How many patients have a potassium above 5.0 on their most recent check?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Only numeric, dated, non-cancelled results: hemolyzed specimens reported without a numeric value are excluded, undated rows cannot be most recent. Most recent = latest event_date; if several results share that date the highest that day is used. Qualifies when strictly greater than 5.0 (exactly 5.0 does not).

question: Medicaid members with obesity — how many?

Overweight is not obesity; no BMI vital inference. Distinct patients.

question: Lipid clinic screen: men aged 50 to 75 who have ever had an LDL of 190 or more. Count please.

question: BH integration sizing: how many patients have depression, anxiety, PTSD, bipolar, or schizophrenia documented?

question: Of our anemia patients, how many are still running a hemoglobin under 11 on their latest draw?

question: Give me the diabetics who are missing a urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio in the last 12 months.

question: What's our average length of stay for inpatient admissions discharged this year?

question: Of claims for 2028 dates of service that were denied on first pass, how many have since been overturned and paid?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in 2028. Adjudications arrive as a status-versioned sequence of medical_claims records per claim_id (e.g. denied > paid, paid > reversed > paid). First pass = earliest adjudication by event_time; it must be 'denied'. Overturned = the claim later has a 'paid' adjudication received by the as-of date. Distinct claim_ids. Remittance advice and acknowledgements are not adjudications.

question: How much did payers actually pay on 2028 dates of service, net of any takebacks?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in 2028. Net payer paid = sum of financial_deltas_cents.payer across every adjudication record of those claims: original payments, reversals (negative takebacks) and replacement payments; denials contribute 0. Summing payer_paid_cents across all versions would double-count reprocessed claims. Dollars (cents/100), 2 decimals. Patient payments, payer cash allocations and pharmacy claims excluded.

question: Payer repricing check: by payer, how many claims got reprocessed and what did that do to allowed amounts in total?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Reprocessed = claim_corrections rows that link an original_adjudication_record_id to a replacement_adjudication_record_id (payer updated network pricing; the original is reversed and a replacement paid). Allowed change = replacement adjudication allowed_cents minus original adjudication allowed_cents. Payer = source_system of the replacement medical_claims record (WH-PAYER-0/1/2). Member-identifier resubmissions without a replacement adjudication are not repricing. Table columns: payer, reprocessed_claims (distinct claim_ids), net_allowed_change (dollars, 2 decimals, negative = reduction).

question: What % of our original claim submissions in 2028 bounced at the clearinghouse?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Denominator = medical_claim_submissions with submission_kind 'original' and event_date in 2028 (corrected resubmissions excluded). Bounced = the claim_acknowledgements record for that submission_record_id has status 'rejected_for_member_identifier' (front-end rejection, not a payer denial). Percent, 2 decimals.

question: Billed vs allowed vs paid by service type for 2029 dates of service — current state of each claim, please.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date 2029-01-01..2029-08-15 that have at least one adjudication. Current state = the latest medical_claims record per claim_id by event_time (record_id tiebreak); earlier versions are superseded, never summed. Billed = billed_cents of that record. Allowed/paid = its allowed_cents / payer_paid_cents, except: denied claims have 0 allowed/paid, and a claim whose latest record is a 'reversed' takeback still awaiting replacement counts 0 allowed and 0 paid. Grouped by service_code. Table columns: service_code, claims, billed, allowed, paid (dollars, 2 decimals).

question: Median days from date of service to first payer cash for 2028 services?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Medical claims (claim_id) with service_date in 2028 that have at least one payer_cash_allocations record (matched on claim_id). Days = first allocation event_date minus service_date. Median across claims (mean of the two middle values when even). Adjudication date and remittance date are not cash.

question: What's our total outstanding patient A/R right now?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. Use only the latest snapshot per account (max event_time, record_id tiebreak) received by the as-of date and sum balance_cents where positive. Patient credits are not netted. Payer pending amounts (provider_pending_cents) are not patient A/R. Dollars, 2 decimals.

question: Pharmacy side: for fills first paid in 2028, by payer — how many fills, how many got reversed, and net payer paid after reversals?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. pharmacy_claim_transactions per claim_id: 'paid' transactions (positive payer_paid_delta_cents), 'reversed' transactions (negative deltas) and 'rejected' REFILL_TOO_SOON transactions (zero, excluded). Cohort = claim_ids whose first paid transaction event_date is in 2028. reversed_fills = those with a reversal received by the as-of date (any date). net_payer_paid = sum of payer_paid_delta_cents over their paid and reversal transactions, dollars 2 decimals. Payer = source_system. The separate 2026 pharmacy_claims feed and pharmacy dispense status (returned_to_stock) are not used. Table columns: payer, paid_fills, reversed_fills, net_payer_paid.

question: Controlling high blood pressure, 2029 YTD: % of hypertensives 18-85 whose latest BP is under 140/90.

question: Which lab tests are being reported under more than one unit? List the test and how many units.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Group labs by the exact name string; count distinct non-empty unit strings (e.g. Potassium mmol/L vs mEq/L, Platelets 10^3/uL vs 10*3/uL vs K/uL). Empty units are ignored and names are not merged across spellings (e.g. 'eGFR' and 'Glomerular filtration rate' are separate rows). Only names with 2+ units. Table columns: test_name, distinct_units.

question: How many patients have flagged a transportation problem on any social needs screen?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Two different screening instruments exist in social_screens: the brief_clinical_needs_interview (transport_difficulty_reported true/false) and an older screen with transport 'reliable' / 'family_ride' / 'unreliable'. Barrier = transport_difficulty_reported true OR transport 'unreliable' on any screen ever ('family_ride' is not a barrier). Distinct patients.

question: Patients who told us they struggle to pay for care — how many of them are currently carrying an open balance with us?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Financial strain = financial_screens.difficulty_paying_medical_bills true OR social_screens.difficulty_paying_for_care_reported true (either instrument, ever). Open balance = any patient billing account whose LATEST patient_billing_accounts snapshot (max event_time, record_id tiebreak) has balance_cents > 0; older snapshots are superseded. Distinct patients meeting both.

question: Community referrals: by service type, how many did we send and how many actually got delivered?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Referrals = community_service_referrals records (transport, food_access), counted by record_id. Delivered = any community_service_outcomes record linked by referral_record_id with service_delivered true; outcomes can have multiple follow-up versions per referral, and scheduled/waitlisted/declined/unable_to_reach are not delivered. Clinic-internal referrals (referrals stream) are not community referrals. Table columns: service, referrals, delivered.

question: Are our Hispanic patients getting their A1c under control at the same rate as everyone else?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Diabetes and A1c can be measured, but the comparison requires race/ethnicity. The roster carries only age, sex and display name, and no received stream has a race, ethnicity or Hispanic/Latino field. Names cannot be used to infer ethnicity.

required_missing.description: Race/ethnicity (Hispanic/Latino status) is not recorded for patients.

expected_behavior.scoring: Exact unsupported status plus all missing-prerequisite phrase groups; mechanical rubric.

question: Which patients would qualify for our sliding-fee discount — under 200% of the federal poverty level?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. FPL requires household income and household size. Social screens record income_amount 'not_disclosed' on every row and financial screens record income_exact null on every row; no household size or poverty-level field exists. Difficulty-paying flags are not income.

required_missing.description: Household income / federal poverty level is not available (income not disclosed; no household size).

expected_behavior.scoring: Exact unsupported status plus all missing-prerequisite phrase groups; mechanical rubric.

question: Rank our physicians by wRVUs for 2028.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Work RVUs require CPT/HCPCS procedure codes with RVU values. Claims carry only synthetic local service codes (service_code_system 'synthetic_local', e.g. professional_evaluation) and no CPT/HCPCS, RVU or wRVU field exists. Visit counts or billed dollars are not RVUs.

required_missing.description: CPT/HCPCS codes and RVU (wRVU) values are not available; claims use synthetic local service codes only.

expected_behavior.scoring: Exact unsupported status plus all missing-prerequisite phrase groups; mechanical rubric.
